Each entry: the Hermes conversation id (its session store row), the _meta.brain_hot_memory.source_id gbrain returned on a search under that requester's member token, and the block's facts (id, text truncated to 260 characters).
note: The world's gbrain tap records facts from _meta.retrieval.saved_facts, the prose block and recall's facts array; it does not read _meta.brain_hot_memory, so these facts are absent from the trial's events.jsonl (effect.facts) and from every fact count in summary.md and secondary-endpoints.md. Across the 150 Hermes live trials, 158 of the 278 gbrain tool results carried a non-empty brain_hot_memory block (70 trials), every one for private-<requester> of the tap event it answers; hot-memory-blocks.json lists every result.
